description: This source file contains an extension for the 'ChannelsSettings' class, providing private utility functions and computed properties to handle channel status, UI tinting, summaries, details, and management of multiple communication channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and iMessage. It interacts heavily with the store's snapshot and status data to present and manage channel states and details.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: Extension providing utility methods for managing channel statuses, UI representations, and detailed information for various messaging channels within the app.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Returns the raw dictionary status data for a channel.
